title: Anthropic passed OpenAI on business AI spend (Ramp AI Index)
description:
Builders: Anthropic now sits at 43.5% of US businesses paying for AI models, against OpenAI's 39.7%.

The figures come from Ramp's AI Index, the July 2026 reading published on August 12, built on corporate card and invoice data from more than 70,000 US businesses. The chart runs the real monthly series: March 2026 at 30.6 against 35.2, the April crossover at 34.4 against 32.3, May at 41.0 against 39.5, and July at 43.5 against 39.7.

One caveat worth saying out loud: this measures how many businesses pay each vendor, not how much they spend.

And the number that matters most if you are building on these models: the flagship tier is only 11.4% of Anthropic's own model spend. Most budgets are buying good enough.

Voice-over is generated.

#ai #startups #anthropic
